notes.glasses: Glasses are not allowed in Australian passport photos since 2018, even with prescription, unless medical certificate provided.
notes.smile: Neutral expression, mouth closed, looking straight at the camera.
notes.ears: Edges of face must be visible. Head coverings allowed for religious reasons only.
notes.shadows: Even lighting with no shadows behind head or under chin.
notes.babyRules: Infants under 3: mouth can be open. Under 1: eyes can be closed. No other person or support visible.
